summary: Listed in Turner County with no build, staffing, fate or present-site source found; the Adams alias belongs to a separate site in Irwin County.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms list: Ashburn tower in Turner County at 31.71707, -83.60345, elevation 392, codes BLL-41135 and gfc-519
tnlandforms list was last revised in March 2016
Forest Lookouts Adams page places Adams in Irwin County
tnlandforms list places its Adams tower in Irwin County, a separate entry

corrections.why: Both sources place the Adams tower in Irwin County (GA227 on tnlandforms; the Forest Lookouts Adams page). The Ashburn tower is in Turner County, so Adams is not an alias of this site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record listed Adams as another name for Ashburn. The two sources put Adams in Irwin County and Ashburn in Turner County, so the alias was dropped from the story.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. Two WebSearch passes (Turner County tower, Georgia Forestry Commission Turner County) found no fire tower record for Ashburn; the only Ashburn tower hit was an antenna structure, not a lookout, and was not used. The record's 'Adams (easternuslookouts.weebly.com)' link points to the Irwin County site and should come off the record's links. The tnlandforms list gives no unit for elevation; the record's 119.5 m assumes feet. Suggest checking Georgia Forestry Commission history records or the Turner County Project archive (turnercountyproject.com).
